entry.summary:
Apologies for the late start - we experienced some technical difficulties getting this livestream started. This livestream begins approximately 10 minutes into the meeting. 

Please note that during our livestreams, there are occasionally instances where our connection is disrupted or unavailable due to technical or operational difficulties. If the livestream recording ends abruptly, please return to our Youtube channel page and refresh the page. We will endeavour to re-establish a new livestream as soon as we can.
